tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Federal Register rules and notices that matter to defense contractors (DFARS, FAR, DoD, DHS, DSCA), newest first. Pay as you go: $0.01/call (x402 USDC on Base or MPP), or 1 call from an API key.

tools.name: list_fms_notices

tools.name: price_to_win
tools.description: Comparable DoD and DHS awards for a product or service code (PSC) or category: obligated value p25, median, p75, competition mix, median offers received, and top winners with share. Use it to size a bid or quote. $0.02/call or 1 credit from an API key.

tools.name: find_contracts_ending
tools.description: Every DoD and DHS contract in a PSC or category whose period of performance ends in the next N days (default 365), biggest first, with incumbent, agency, offers received and competition type. $0.02/call or 1 credit from an API key.

tools.name: get_sub_network
tools.description: Prime to sub network for one company from DoD and DHS subcontract reports (FY2024 on): who it pays as a prime and which primes pay it as a sub, with dollar totals and dates. $0.02/call or 1 credit from an API key.

tools.name: get_registration

tools.name: search_exclusions
tools.description: Search the SAM.gov exclusions list (debarred, suspended, or otherwise barred firms and people) by name, UEI, CAGE, excluding agency, classification or start date. active=1 keeps only exclusions in force today. $0.02/call or 1 credit from an API key.

tools.name: search_subawards
tools.description: DoD and DHS subcontract records (FY2024 on) for a prime contract (piid) or a company as prime or as sub (role=prime|sub), biggest first. $0.02/call or 1 credit from an API key.

tools.name: search_past_solicitations
tools.description: Past and current DoD and DHS contract opportunities from SAM.gov (FY2024 on), filtered by NAICS, PSC, title words, set-aside or company, each linked to the resulting award where one exists, with days from posting to award. $0.02/call or 1 credit from an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_fms_notices, search_grid_interconnection_queue · Private data: search_rules, list_fms_notices, price_to_win, find_contracts_ending, get_sub_network, get_registration, search_exclusions, search_subawards, search_past_solicitations, search_awards, get_company, latest_awards, find_sell_now_opportunities, find_expiring_recompetes, search_contract_documents, request_contract_documents, list_allied_and_fms, search_grid_interconnection_queue · Public sink: price_to_win, request_owner_payment, get_global_trends · Destructive: get_global_trends.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_fms_notices, search_grid_interconnection_queue · Private data: search_rules, list_fms_notices, price_to_win, find_contracts_ending, get_sub_network, get_registration, search_exclusions, search_subawards, search_past_solicitations, search_awards, get_company, latest_awards, find_sell_now_opportunities, find_expiring_recompetes, search_contract_documents, request_contract_documents, list_allied_and_fms, search_grid_interconnection_queue · Public sink: price_to_win, request_owner_payment, get_global_trends · Destructive: get_global_trends

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
